svg.title: APEX 12 — How an organisation decides to buy APEX
svg.text: How an organisation decides to buy APEX
Eight evaluation stages, from recognising the need to the signature. At each stage different stakeholders join, raise a
predictable objection and must pass an approval gate. Anticipating each objection keeps the decision moving.

g.text: How to keep the decision moving
Send the security & governance brief before the technical
Agree pilot success criteria in writing before the pilot
Build the business case from pilot data, not projections.
Disclose roadmap gaps (SSO, hosting, data export) early

svg.text: Plan the deal backwards from the signature: know who approves each gate, prepare the answer to
each objection before it is raised, and let pilot evidence — not promises — carry the business case.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
